evidence.statement: Seven receding square levels are visible in all side views.
Four dark stair arms run from base to top on all four sides.
The top structure has four corner pillars and a roof.
Facts report 7 horizontal surface levels and a periodic stud pattern of about 5 % of the extent.

hypotheses.label: Generic step pyramid with a temple on top
hypotheses.strongest_counterargument: Many unrelated designs share a stepped square body.
